6a62745a9fc11309026096c9.working: Sum_{k=1}^{n} C_k C_{k-1} = coefficient of x^{n-1} in (1+x)^{2n} = 2nC(n-1). Option (D) 2nC(n+1) equals 2nC(n-1) by symmetry. Option (B): (2n+2)C(n+1) = 2nC(n+1) + 2*2nC(n) + 2nC(n-1) = 2*2nC(n-1) + 2*2nC(n), so (1/2)(2n+2)C(n+1) - 2nC(n) = 2nC(n-1). Both B and D are correct.
